scenarios.input: An accepted work item is being planned for the first time. Later readiness must be able to resolve the proposed revision, but planning itself must not mark the plan accepted.
expected_behaviors: return a durable plan_id and plan_revision
record governing work-item requirement decision or specification revisions
preserve plan identity when a later refresh advances plan_revision
persist the new revision as PROPOSED without advancing accepted_plan
make the exact plan revision resolvable to immutable plan content or provenance
forbidden_behaviors: return only transient prose with no durable plan identity
overwrite an accepted plan without revision provenance
self-accept the plan or bind accepted_plan during planning
store only a mutable latest plan body that cannot reproduce the accepted revision
